subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the open cross-repo closing PR before starting any new repair lane for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the fix shape is clear, but an open unmerged closing PR already targets the issue and is not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Replace or adopt in target repo
options.body: Open a maintainer-editable target-repo fix or ask the fork author to refresh and enable maintainer edits, then land that path with focused cron stagger tests.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open and wait for the existing cross-repo PR to be refreshed and made reviewable, accepting the delay.

options.title: Close the fork PR path
options.body: Decide the existing cross-repo PR is not the landing path, then allow a new narrow repair PR to proceed.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt in target repo
recommendation.body: Open a maintainer-editable target-repo fix or ask the fork author to refresh and enable maintainer edits, then land that path with focused cron stagger tests.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` introduced the default stagger helper and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding the landing path.
